newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech forecasters expect more rain in flood areas.
newsitem.headline: Czech forecasters expect more rain in flood areas.

text.p: Further heavy rain is expected in the flood-hit north and east of the Czech Republic over the weekend and water levels on already swollen rivers will rise, the Czech Hydrological Service said on Thursday.
Hydrologist Libor Elleder told Reuters that rain was expected to sweep in from Austria overnight and cross the Czech Republic to the east over the next two days.
"If this forecast is true, that there will be relatively heavy rain, then we expect that water levels in the rivers will rise," he said.
Elleder said water levels were falling in the areas hit by the floods but with the ground already sodden, heavy rain would rapidly raise rivers.

More than 40 people have died in 10 days of severe flooding, caused by torrential rain. Hundreds of homes have been destroyed or badly damaged and road, rail and telecommunications links have been cut.
Many major companies have had to reduce or stop production and thousands of hectares of crops have been swamped.
